user_query: I am organizing a team-building event for my company and I need your help in planning some invigorating activities. Can you recommend some team-building games and exercises that promote teamwork and motivation? Additionally, I am interested in gathering news articles about successful team-building events to get some inspiration.

TaskList.description: Research and compile a list of team-building games and exercises that promote teamwork and motivation.
Gather news articles about successful team-building events for inspiration.
Compile the findings from the team-building games and the news articles into a cohesive planning document.
